notes: The defining Unity vertical in Serbia. Nordeus (Belgrade, Take-Two — Top Eleven), Two Desperados, Playstudios Serbia, Peaksel. The Serbian Games Association reports ~4,300 industry professionals and 47% of Serbian games built in Unity. F2P live-ops experience commands the top of the market

B2B casino/slot suppliers and operator dev hubs in Belgrade and Novi Sad use Unity for client-side game builds. Pays close to mobile F2P but with far fewer Unity-specific openings; limited published bands

Mad Head Games, Ubisoft Belgrade, Eipix. Real console/PC presence, but the larger studios here lean Unreal and proprietary engines — Unity seats are fewer and pay near the market median rather than above it
Small enterprise/industrial XR niche plus a handful of startups. Unity is the default engine but hiring volume is thin; no reliable Head-level data
Training and simulation work is mostly project-based for foreign clients. Small niche, pay below the games market

Serbia is a major nearshore destination, so this is the highest-volume Unity employer type — co-dev, porting and staff augmentation for EU/US clients. It is also the lowest-paying: rates run roughly 20-25% below product studios
Gamified-learning and training-content studios hire Unity devs occasionally; most Serbian EdTech is web-native. Lowest-paying vertical for Unity in the country. Single-digit sample — indicative only
